svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One print: a plate 104 x 64 x 3 mm and a cradle 4 mm thick, 46 mm wide,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 44 mm long, hanging below the street end at 25 degrees from upright.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print with the plate flat on the bed and the cradle overhanging.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 3.4 mm holes 94 mm apart along and 54 mm apart across, to match

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the four bosses in the box (measure your box first).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cradle: two 2.7 mm holes to match the radar module's mounting holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The module sits 3 mm off the cradle on nylon spacers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head board: four M3 standoffs 6 mm long on the underside,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the board's corner holes, 4 mm in from each edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head board port outputs follow the M12 pinout: pin 1 12 V, pin 3 ground,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pins 2 and 4 RS-485, pin 5 wake; the lead plugs are marked 1 to 5.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M3 screws into the bosses from below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the radar face then tips 25 degrees down toward the street.
